_about: Bahoshy Softball Field (decisions/0023, redrawn in 0029): as in the satellite photo, home plate in the south-east corner by a paved plaza, an all-dirt infield, the outfield fanning north-west towards the tennis courts and Murphy Field with a red-brown warning track. A landmark.
